_about: Still cameras of HollowMere's outskirts, for meshy_village_look.py --views-file (render with --look tools/blender/meshy_looks/final.json): name -> [[eye x, eye y, eye height], [target x, target y, target z], lens mm, options]. x and y are corner tile units of the village map (the look's tile_xy: world x = (tx - 32) * 1.5, world y = (24 - ty) * 1.5); the eye height is above HM_Ground when the option ground is true (the look's default: eye height under 25 and ty under 37), else absolute world z; the target z is world z. The village build (meshy_village_outskirts.view_trees) reads this file: it clears the forest trees on these sightlines and near these lenses and gives the near ones smooth near masters, so a change here wants a rebuild.
